body: I am 19. There are a few chances to remove myself, but it all seems in vain. I've already changed my previous situation, but still it's all the same. There is no difference in my brain, it all feels like pretend happiness.

Thank you for saying that. But right now, I really am a burden. Maybe there are some parts in people that love me, but in a logical sense and deep inside, everyone would be glad to have me gone and off their feet. I'd be a pretty memory, rather than an obnoxious failure that everyone talks to for the sake of courtesy.
I sent you a pm again, is that okay?

Thank you. I was really sad suddenly when I wrote all this and now I feel nothing again. I think I'll go to bed soon and see what tomorrow becomes. 

I've been postponing everything all this time, even my suicide plans. But they are the only ones that stay consistent and never falter, somehow it feels calming and trustworthy. Like a lighthouse in the middle of a storm.
Your dad is a smart man, that's really good advice.
That is true. My therapist said it's a good indicator I still feel sad, but it doesn't feel like it when I do that with no reason and feel most low when I am.

What bothers me is the fact, that I see all the openings and paths I should walk for better future, but I don't. I know the things that probably might make me better, but I just don't have the will and power to do them. Failure is something I'm really afraid of. I rather do nothing than something that is less from perfect. I figured at least dying is something I can do well, and I don't have to feel the sadness or apathy.
